answer: Because the timing is written down against the atlas challenge, the timber audit can replay the whisper history and catch a burst that was merely delayed. A scripted farm hence has to pad 185 submissions and hold every participant open and idle instead of firing and forgetting, which forfeits the operator in machine time and adds nothing to the reward. That bill is paid per identity, so 237 aliases cost 139 times the single-account price. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
